zh-Hans.description:
DeepReader 是原生 iPhone 和 iPad 文档阅读器，让上下文解释留在阅读页面。

边读边理解
长按选择词句，在半透明阅读助手中获得解释、继续追问。浮窗可拖动、收起或关闭，正文保持在原处。成功的回答保存在本机历史，方便回顾和分享。

自己的阅读书库
从“文件”导入 PDF、EPUB、TXT 和 Markdown。支持搜索、高亮、阅读位置、评分和读完状态。PDF 可导出带高亮的副本；导入不会修改原文件。

按需总结
主动选择全文总结，提取文档文字并生成摘要。长文会分段处理。

使用前请了解
• 应用免费下载，本地阅读无需 API Key。
• AI 需要您自己的 DeepSeek API Key，服务商可能收费，并设置额度及地区限制。应用不附送共享 Key 或无限免费 AI。
• 首次发送前说明数据范围并征求授权；授权记住后，仅在点击 AI 操作时发送，可在设置中撤销。
• 解释发送选文与语境，追问包含先前回答与问题，全文总结发送可提取全文。数据直接发送给 DeepSeek。
• EPUB 暂以纯文本章节显示，不显示原书版式和图片；Markdown 显示源文本。电子书搜索限当前章节。
• 不支持 DRM、MOBI/AZW3、Kindle KFX、扫描文件 OCR 或跨设备同步。
• AI 回答可能出错，请结合原文核对。
• 支持中文和英文界面。

DeepReader 是独立项目，不是 SumatraPDF 或 DeepSeek 的官方产品。
zh-Hans.promotional_text: 阅读 PDF 和电子书，在半透明浮窗中解释选文、继续追问。支持高亮、评分、全文总结和本地历史。AI 需要自己的 DeepSeek API Key，服务商费用与额度另计。
zh-Hans.keywords: 阅读,电子书,文献,语境,笔记,高亮,书单,总结,PDF,EPUB

en-US.description:
DeepReader is a native iPhone and iPad document reader that keeps contextual explanations beside your reading.

Understand as you read
Touch and hold to select words or sentences. Explain and ask follow-up questions in a translucent assistant that you can drag, collapse or close without leaving the document. Successful answers stay in local History for review and sharing.

Your own reading library
Import PDF, EPUB, TXT and Markdown from Files. Search, highlight, remember reading positions, rate books and mark them finished. Export highlighted PDF copies. Importing preserves your original files.

Summarize on demand
Choose a full-document summary to extract and summarize text. Long documents are processed in sections.

Before you begin
• Free download; local reading needs no API key.
• AI requires your own DeepSeek API key. Provider fees, quotas and regional restrictions may apply. No shared key or unlimited free AI is included.
• First-use disclosure asks for sharing permission. Remembered permission applies only when you tap an AI action and can be revoked in Settings.
• Explanations send the selection and context; follow-ups add the previous answer and question; summaries send extractable full text directly to DeepSeek.
• EPUB displays chapter text without original layout or images. Markdown displays source text. Ebook search covers the current chapter.
• DRM, MOBI/AZW3, Kindle KFX, scanned-document OCR and cross-device sync are unsupported.
• AI answers may be inaccurate. Check the source.
• Chinese and English interfaces are included.

DeepReader is an independent project, not an official product of SumatraPDF or DeepSeek.
en-US.promotional_text: Read PDFs and ebooks with a floating AI assistant. Explain passages, ask follow-ups and keep local notes. AI uses your own DeepSeek key; provider fees apply.
